reauth_confirm.title: Re-register bunq API access
reauth_confirm.description: Your bunq API credentials were rejected, so the integration can no longer fetch data. Continue to re-authorize access with bunq. You can adjust the dynamic IP setting below before re-registering.

data_description.allow_dynamic_ip: Register the device server with a wildcard IP (`*`) instead of your current IP. Enable this if your ISP assigns a new IP address frequently. Note: this reduces account security.

abort.oauth_error: Could not register with the bunq API using these credentials. Make sure your bunq plan still includes API access.
